title: test models that count refused input fail under exudynCPPfast
author: Claude-JG
description: the fast-module suite of the 1.13 release: createItemNumbersTest raised (the Create functions skip the item-kind checks in exudynCPPfast, so a node reaches AddMarker and raises ExudynTypeError instead of ValueError), homogeneousTransformationInterfaceTest counted 3 must-raise cases that raise nothing there, ANCFThinPlateRevisionTest failed testInvalidIntegrationModeRaises; these cases are judged only in the regular module, as symbolicModuleTest does ('[FAST]' in exu.config.Version(True))
releaseNotes: createItemNumbersTest, homogeneousTransformationInterfaceTest and ANCFThinPlateRevisionTest judge refused input only in the regular module; exudynCPPfast skips these checks by design. revision2026b step RG2.7
